name: Amongst the seasons
source:
Kazuki lost his parents when he was young, he doesn’t remember much about them. Apart from that they were worshipers and followers of a local god known as the weather god that looks like a dragon. The weather god was said to protect and maintain the weather of the town he leaves in. The only memento of them is in a form of a necklace with a symbol of the weather god, in which Kazuki wears for good luck.

Shortly when Kazuki lost his parents, he met 4 friends in day care named after the seasons Haru, Natsu, Aki and Fuyu. From there the 5 became childhood friends. Kazuki was taken in by Haru's family. 

Skip to present day, 1 month in his new school Shiki high school. Kazuki is concerned about not knowing what club to join. Compared to his other childhood friends Kazuki has no special talent or any hobbies and interests. He is worried about his future and lack of direction in his life. Haru and his other friends concerned for him suggest that Kazuki should try their clubs for one day everyday in a week.

From there Kazuki makes a decision that changes his life and the others around him.

[From [url=http://amongst-the-seasons.weebly.com/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一树幼时就失去了父母，对他们的事记不太清楚。除此之外，他们还是当地神灵的崇拜者和追随者，这个神灵被称为“天气神”，它看起来像一条龙。据说，天气之神会保护并维持他所离开的城镇的天气。唯一的纪念品是一条带有天气之神的象征的项链，一树戴着它会带来好运。

一树失去父母后不久，他在日托中心遇到了4个以季节命名的朋友，分别是Haru、Natsu、Aki和Fuyu。从此，五人成了儿时好友。一树被春的家人收留了。

跳转到现在，他在新学校志木高中1个月了。一树因为不知道该加入哪个社团而烦恼。与其他儿时好友相比，一树没有什么特殊的才能，也没有什么爱好和兴趣。他对自己的未来感到担忧，对人生缺乏方向。Haru和其他关心他的朋友建议Kazuki应该在一周内每天尝试他们的俱乐部一天。

从那时起，一树做出了一个决定，改变了他和周围其他人的生活。

[来自[url=http://amongst-the-seasons.weebly.com/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
